Are you accurate, flexible, and do you enjoy working in a clean production environment? For a modern food company in Zottegem, we are looking for packers.

Below is the list of tasks for this position:

• Correctly packaging fine food products according to the established standards. 
• Carrying out quality checks to ensure that every product meets our high standards. 
• Setting up and adjusting machines to guarantee a smooth production process. 
• Working together with colleagues to ensure deadlines are met and customers remain satisfied. 
• As a packer, you make sure our products are perfectly packaged before they are sent to our customers.

• You can speak Dutch or English.
• You can work either from 6h-14h, 14h-22h or 22h-6h. 
• You are at least 3 days a week available to work.
• You can choose which day and shift you wanna work.
• You have experience in a production environment.

Forum is looking for Operators in Zottegem urgently! 
Your responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and reconfiguring production equipment on a production line.
• You will be able to work on various machines.
• You will clean the machines, equipment, and conveyor belts.
• You will be responsible for quality control.
• You will work in two shifts, Monday through Friday (6:00 AM–2:00 PM and 2:00 PM–10:00 PM).

Who are you?

• You have a technical background, either through a degree or work experience
• You have some initial experience as a technical operator
• You are motivated
• You have a consistent work history
• You speak English well

We are looking for a Machine Operator (Carpentry) for a company that specializes in making caskets!

What will your responsibilities be?

• Planing and sawing products
• Operating the gluing machine
• Conducting quality checks on products
• Operating a forklift
Work hours: 12:30 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.

Who are you?

• You’re open to physical work
• Forklift experience or a certificate is a plus
• You speak Dutch, English, or Polish
• You’re open to working a fixed afternoon shift
• You have your own transportation

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators. 
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry. 
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following: 
 
 

• Engine Incoming Inspection 

• Engine Storage, Humidity Checks and Humidity Corrections 

• Engine Preservation 

• Engine Boroscope inspection 

• Engine Boroblending  

• Engine handling, QEC removal and installation 

• Engine inspection at major module level, Inventory Checks and Lease Return Work Scope (LRWS) / C-Checks iaw B-rating 

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level 

• High level of reading and writing technical English is a must 

• High level of computer literacy will be required for daily tasks 

• Have the ability to work within a small team and act independently when required 

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will also act as a point of reference for the accounting team and support colleagues with complex or non-routine matters.

Your responsibilities:

• Coordinate the administration related to invoices and commitments, including leasing, housekeeping, payroll, real estate taxes and travel expenses.
• Monitor relevant expenditures against budget and follow up with external parties such as suppliers, municipalities and surveyors when required.
• Coordinate the external audit process and prepare or review audit documentation and samples.
• Review account reconciliations, including accruals, prepayments and suspense accounts, as well as payroll reconciliations in cooperation with the Payroll Manager.
• Contribute to month-end closing and management reporting by analysing account movements and explaining significant fluctuations.
• Ensure accurate intercompany accounting and recharges.
• Coordinate VAT, real estate tax and other relevant tax compliance activities together with the Tax department.
• Support budgeting activities and the preparation and review of statutory accounts.
• Contribute to financial reporting for subsidiaries in line with IFRS and local GAAP.
• Support accounting activities related to mergers, acquisitions and entity integrations.
• Coordinate local GAAP accounting memos where required.
• Ensure appropriate accounting procedures, controls and systems are implemented and followed.
• Participate in European finance projects, including system implementations, entity integrations, IFRS migrations and updates to policies and procedures.
• Contribute to process improvements and other ad-hoc finance projects.
• Support the Accounting Manager in guiding the Corporate Accounting team and provide advice on non-routine accounting matters.
• Help onboard and train new and existing team members.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent professional experience.
• At least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Solid experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within a services or retail environment.
• Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with CRM/ERP migration or upgrade projects, particularly UAT, key-user or training responsibilities.
• SAP experience is required; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is an advantage.
• Experience in a multi-country or shared-services environment is a plus.
• Previous management experience is an advantage.
• Fluent in English and French. German is considered a strong asset, while additional market languages are a plus.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft applications and advanced Excel skills.

What you will do
 
 

• Operate and monitor high-tech automated machines to ensure uninterrupted production. 

• Maintain accurate performance and efficiency of the tools as qualified user. 

• Follow and understand procedures, instructions and WoW quickly and apply them correctly. 

• Able to act correctly and clearly under pressure and ask support when needed.  

• Quickly identify and report any issues or malfunctions to First Line Support (FLS) or WIP lead. 

• Follow safety and operational procedures to maintain a secure and efficient work environment. 

• Communicate in clear language and understandable terms (also in English) and participate actively in shift handover.  

• Keep everything tidy according to 5S rules. 

• Refill chemicals. 

Who you are
 
 

• Experience in operations environment or a similar field is preferred, but we focus on potential. 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. 

• Good communication and teamwork skills. 

• Proactive, detail-oriented and dynamic. 

• Knowledge of English  

Below is an example of the shift schedule, providing a clear understanding of the work hours and rotation you can expect in this role:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift (06:15 – 14:15) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift (21:45 – 06:30) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift (14:00 – 22:00) from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h - (06:30 – 18:30)  

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday, you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift (14:00 – 22:00). 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift. (06:15 – 14:15).

Responsibilities

• Develop and oversee the data and solution architecture for a strategic platform modernization initiative.
• Analyze existing application and data structures to define future-state architectural goals.
• Design scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native solutions within the Azure ecosystem.
• Provide expert guidance to development teams and stakeholders regarding technical choices and architectural best practices.
• Manage and support the Azure DevOps environment to streamline technical delivery.
• Ensure seamless integration between legacy systems and modern architectural components.
• Support governance, security, and compliance requirements within the architecture domain.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in data architecture and complex enterprise data modeling.
• You bring 5+ years of experience with Azure DevOps administration and management.
• You possess 5+ years of experience writing SQL queries for data analysis.
• You have 3+ years of experience within the Belgian energy sector.
• You bring experience in designing microservices and cloud-native architecture.
• You possess the skills to translate conceptual information models into logical data models.
• You're experienced in defining and implementing a technical test strategy.
• You are fluent in English with C1 level proficiency in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Python programming.
• Knowledge of UMIG 6 and UMIG DGO processes.

Responsibilities

• Develop and validate AI platform functionality using LLM harnesses and agent workflows.
• Translate business needs into user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
• Onboard teams to new AI capabilities through workshops, demonstrations, and hands-on sessions.
• Measure and collect user feedback to drive continuous improvement of the platform.
• Assess internal and external AI capabilities to provide recommendations for future enhancements.
• Maintain clear documentation ensuring traceability from business requirements to technical implementation.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in functional analysis, requirements engineering, and process modeling.
• You bring technical knowledge of LLM harnesses, agent workflows, RAG, and prompt engineering.
• You possess a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure tools such as Azure, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
• You're skilled in designing test scenarios and automated evaluations for model behavior and tool integration.
• You have experience inspecting logs and agent execution traces to debug issues related to token usage, context, and latency.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with a proven track record in stimulating user adoption and onboarding.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Development experience in Python and TypeScript.
• Knowledge of Figma and design thinking practices.
• Experience with Targetprocess or similar Agile project management platforms.
• Familiarity with digital user experience, web design, or marketing content design.

Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - Major Migration Programme - Brussels

Are you an experienced SAP S/4HANA specialist looking to play a key advisory role in a major transformation project?

We are partnering with a leading organisation in the Belgian financial services sector undertaking a strategic SAP ECC to S/4HANA Brownfield migration.

This is an opportunity to support the transformation of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Business Partner processes while working closely with internal business and master data teams.

As a trusted functional expert, you will help stakeholders understand SAP standard functionalities, evaluate available solutions and ensure a smooth transition towards S/4HANA.
Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - The Job
You will:

• Advise business teams on SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner and Customer Vendor Integration (CVI).
• Assess differences between ECC and S/4HANA, recommend standard solutions and evaluate impacts on master data and P2P/O2C processes.
• Support business stakeholders through functional guidance, knowledge transfer, testing activities and validation of implementation partner recommendations.
Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - Your Profile
You have:

• Strong functional expertise in SAP FI-AP, FI-AR, Business Partner and CVI, including customer and supplier master data.
• Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA, ideally involving ECC to S/4HANA migrations and integration with MM/SD processes.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex SAP functionalities to non-technical business stakeholders.
Fluent English is required; Dutch is a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Adoption Manager – Digital Transformation & Change Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Develop pragmatic adoption plans for digital initiatives including communication, enablement, and follow-up KPIs.
• Engage proactively with product and project teams to ensure solutions are ready for successful field implementation.
• Organize train-the-trainer sessions and develop practical material such as training packages and implementation guides.
• Facilitate recurrent adoption forums with network representatives to capture feedback and identify barriers.
• Track network implementation and maintain clear adoption metrics and reporting.
• Translate complex project information into simple, actionable material for field teams and internal stakeholders.

Requirements

• Experience in change management, digital transformation, or network enablement.
• You possess strong roll-out capabilities and the ability to drive adoption strategies operationally.
• You're comfortable facilitating workshops, training, and train-the-trainer sessions.
• You bring proficiency in Office 365 and SharePoint.
• You have experience working with adoption metrics and turning data into improvement actions.
• You possess a critical mindset combined with strong stakeholder management skills.
• You're proactive and able to translate complex product information into actionable field material.
• You are fluent in English with full professional proficiency in either Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with structured change methodologies such as ADKAR.
• Previous experience in automotive, retail, or franchise network environments.
• Experience with large-scale digital transformation programs involving User Journey mapping.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Digital Payments & PCI-DSS
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of the digital payment ecosystem modernization, including the procurement and implementation of new acquiring and PSP services.
• Drive the compliance and certification efforts for the payment ecosystem, ensuring full adherence to regulatory standards.
• Orchestrate cross-functional teams across finance, legal, security, and architecture to consolidate complex business and technical requirements.
• Define the target architecture for payment flows and manage technical transitions between legacy and future service providers.
• Monitor project risks, dependencies, budgets, and timelines while providing strategic reporting to senior management.
• Direct the preparation of public procurement documents, technical specifications, and tender evaluations for large-scale IT and payment services.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in complex project management within regulated environments.
• You bring 3+ years of specialized expertise in electronic payments, including PSP, Acquiring, and monetics.
• You possess a proven track record in PCI-DSS compliance projects or comparable payment security initiatives.
• You're experienced in public procurement, including drafting RFP specifications and managing tender processes.
• You have advanced skills in budget management and risk and dependency management.
• You possess strong Supplier Relationship Management skills, particularly with IT and payment service providers.
• You have experience working within Agile frameworks and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with exceptional analytical and synthesis capabilities.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Certification in PRINCE2 Practitioner or Project Management Professional (PMP).
• Knowledge of Account Based Ticketing (ABT) or EMV payment systems.
• Experience in test management for payment solutions.

jobs.occupation: IT Project Manager – Application Integration & Data Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Analyze user requirements and collaborate with external partners to design effective technical solutions.
• Coordinate cross-application implementations and integrations while maintaining the integrity of the overarching data model.
• Lead multiple IT projects, serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and third-party IT vendors.
• Oversee validation activities and participate in active testing to ensure high-quality software delivery.
• Monitor application availability and security while implementing continuous improvements to the IT landscape.
• Manage implementation risks and challenge business requests to ensure alignment with technical governance.

Requirements

• You have experience in professional roles such as IT Functional Analyst, Project Manager, or Data Expert.
• You possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent expertise.
• You bring experience with IT Governance processes, specifically focusing on Release Management and Change Management.
• You possess strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset with the ability to investigate data-level issues independently.
• You're a clear and proactive communicator, capable of managing relationships with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
• You are native in Dutch with a strong knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes or the Telecom industry.
• Technical familiarity with SQL, Scripting, or ETL processing.
• Experience working with GIS data.
• Curiosity regarding emerging IT evolutions and a drive for continuous optimization.

Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of product features from initial analysis and technical design through to implementation and deployment.
• Act as the technical point of reference and domain owner for specific product areas.
• Build and maintain software across the full stack with a heavy focus on backend engineering.
• Translate product and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and practical technical solutions.
• Collaborate with Product Owners to make informed trade-offs between product value and technical sustainability.
• Contribute to engineering excellence in areas such as architecture, testing, CI/CD, and operational reliability.
• Share technical knowledge and mentor team members to raise the overall technical level.

Requirements

• 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a solid backend foundation.
• You have experience designing, building, and operating software in production using Docker and Kubernetes.
• You possess a good understanding of modern SaaS concepts such as API design, distributed systems, authentication, and multi-tenancy.
• You bring experience with data technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Elasticsearch.
• You have worked with modern delivery practices including CI/CD and automated deployments.
• You're comfortable investigating root causes and reasoning about architectural trade-offs.
• You possess a product mindset, focusing on solving core problems rather than just implementing features.
• You are fluent in Dutch with a good command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Hands-on experience with Golang as a primary backend language.
• Experience with Vue.js for frontend interface development.
• Knowledge of large-scale data processing using Kafka or Parquet.
• Experience with object storage platforms such as Ceph S3.
• Interest in using AI to strengthen engineering practices.
